topology.operator_runtime: Python 3.11 or later standard library plus a modern WebGL2 browser
topology.served_surface: explicit application configuration public-geometry and selected-presentation-bundle allowlist
topology.runtime_input_form: prepared JSON presentation bundle keyed by GEOID plus separate public GeoJSON

renderer.name: MapLibre GL JS
renderer.purpose: WebGL2 map interaction raster-basemap composition and local GeoJSON choropleth rendering
renderer.versioning_strategy: Exact vendored minor version and file hashes; update deliberately after license security conformance and local performance review.
renderer.maintenance_posture: Active community project using semantic versioning; replacement is isolated behind the presentation map adapter.
renderer.replacement_boundary: presentation/arch01/site/app.mjs map initialization source layer style and interaction functions

local_neutral.label: Local neutral
local_neutral.purpose: Fail-safe tract interaction without external context.

usgs_topo.label: Streets / topo
usgs_topo.purpose: Required recognizable roads highways place labels water and geographic orientation.
usgs_topo.attribution: Map services and data available from U.S. Geological Survey, National Geospatial Program.
usgs_topo.license: U.S. public domain map service; acknowledgment requested

usgs_imagery_topo.label: Aerial + labels
usgs_imagery_topo.purpose: Optional public-domain orthoimagery with US Topo reference context.
usgs_imagery_topo.attribution: USDA, USGS The National Map: Orthoimagery and US Topo.
usgs_imagery_topo.license: U.S. public domain map service for the conterminous United States; acknowledgment requested

network_egress.allowed_payload: Viewport-derived public raster tile z row and column identifiers plus ordinary HTTPS request metadata.
network_egress.provider_logging_posture: USGS states that its sites automatically log domain IP address browser operating system time referrer approximate country/state pages and requested information for internal site management and security.
network_egress.prohibited_payload: Protected or synthetic-canary values identities coordinates Seed Context sales predictions errors lineage paths handles credentials and local bundle content.
network_egress.failure_behavior: Retain local tract interaction and show explicit basemap-unavailable status using the local-neutral background.
